text: At dusk, this coach could only see a body and read a table. It knew no sport.
I haven't learned running yet. Want me to learn it? Once I know it, every member can use it.
The member says yes. The coach writes its own tool and its tests, tries it on this run, checks it can only compute, then installs it.
Treat these readings as a snapshot rather than a full picture of your running.
Two people in frame, an AI-made clip. The coach asks which one to watch, then reuses jump rope. Learning cost: $0.

text: At dawn it does things it could not do at dusk. Its authority never changed.
